samples.question: Three L-shaped solid regions are drawn, one red, one blue, one green, each inside its own column and all sharing one identical bounding box. A shape's center of mass (the balance point of its filled area) can sit off the center of its own bounding box. Which colored shape has its center of mass FARTHEST from the center of its own bounding box, i.e. is the most lopsided? Answer with only the color: red, blue, or green.
